subject: Conditional net terms, entity-split invoices & credit ramp proposal
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <ap-finance@novaprospect.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to move the pilot to a paid PoC. Before we finalize the SOW we'd like to align on payment terms and VAT handling across our EMEA/US entities. A few asks from our finance team:

- Can Redwood accommodate Net60 on the consolidated account for the pilot?
- For EU consumption, we need invoices split by legal entity (NovaProspect UK Ltd / NovaProspect NL BV) so we can apply reverse-charge where applicable.
- We also need a credit cap in place for the first 60 days while we validate usage patterns (suggested EUR 75k cap).

Apologies if this is granular — our AP team needs this before we route the PO. Happy to take a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Liam
Finance Lead
NovaProspect

--
Attachment: 1) np_po_template.pdf (stub)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear asks. Wanted to propose an approach that balances underwriting risk with NovaProspect's procurement needs:

Proposal (conditional):
- Initial window: Net45 for the first three invoices, after which we move to Net60 provided no payment delinquency is observed.
- Early-pay rebate: 1.5% if paid within 15 days (applies to invoices issued to the consolidated account).
- Credit cap: initial cap EUR 50k for the first 30 days, automatically reviewed at day 30 with the option to increase to EUR 150k after validation (approval by finance).
- Invoicing split: We can issue entity-specific invoices for EU entities — we will need VAT registration evidence for each entity to apply reverse-charge.
- Requirement: Signed mutual action plan and PO referencing the agreed credit cap. We can accept a DocuSign route for the MPA and payment schedule.

Can you circulate the VAT certificate(s) for the UK/NL entities? Marissa — can you prepare a short payment-ramp PDF I can share that outlines the cap and escalation? Neha — FYI on the conditional clause and failure-to-pay remediation (we'll want a limited holdback right until credit cap resets).

If this looks broadly acceptable, I'll draft the MPA and start the DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Hi Liam / Hannah — adding some concrete numbers so AP can see the schedule:

- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears, generated on the 1st of the month.
- First invoice (covering pilot activation) due Net45 (per Hannah's conditional proposal).
- Credit ramp (illustrative):
  * Day 0-30: EUR 50,000 cap (manual alerts to NovaProspect and Redwood finance at 85% utilization).
  * Day 31-60: auto-escalate to EUR 100,000 if invoices paid on time; require exec sponsor sign-off to go to EUR 150,000.
- Collections: late fee applies after 10 days past due (0.5% weekly, capped at 5%).
- VAT handling: we'll need the VAT certificate(s) and a billing contact per entity for delivery of entity-specific invoices.

I've attached a one-pager (redwood_payment_ramp.pdf) that we use for pilots — it includes the notification and escalation workflow. Vivek — can you confirm that our billing system can emit separate entity invoices tied to the same master account?

Liam — if NovaProspect agrees to the ramp above, we'll prepare the MPA and send it via DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_payment_ramp.pdf (stub)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <ap-finance@novaprospect.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 15:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Thanks Marissa — that schedule is sensible and close to what we can operationalize. Attached the VAT certificate for NovaProspect NL BV (see vat_certificate_novaprospect.pdf). The UK entity is still pending a minor update (I should have that by Friday).

Two quick clarifications:
1) On the early-pay rebate — does that apply to entity-specific invoices as well, or only to consolidated invoices?
2) For the credit cap increase at day 31, can we get an automatic notification and a 3-business-day window to request an increase before it takes effect? Our procurement needs to be able to sign off quickly.

We'll accept the DocuSign MPA for signatures. Please include a field in the MPA that records the initial credit cap so the PO matches the agreement.

Best,
Liam

--

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Quick legal note on default / remediation language:
- We can accept the conditional ramp and Net45 -> Net60 progression but would like the MPA to include a 30-day cure period for payment defaults before any service suspension.
- Also request explicit language that VAT credits / reverse-charge claims are the customer's responsibility and that Redwood will rely on the VAT registration evidence provided.

If NovaProspect can sign those two points, legal is comfortable moving forward.

-Neha
General Counsel (contracts)
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaprospect.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for Redwood pilot

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick turn.

Summary / next steps (agreed in principle):
- Invoice cadence: monthly, Net45 for first three invoices then Net60 if no defaults.
- Early-pay rebate: 1.5% within 15 days (applies to both consolidated and entity-specific invoices — accepted).
- Initial credit cap: EUR 50k (day 0-30) with automatic alert at 85% and auto-escalation to EUR 100k on day 31 unless NovaProspect requests hold within 3 business days.
- VAT: we received NL certificate; please send the UK certificate when ready. Redwood will issue entity-specific invoices when provided with each entity's billing contact and VAT evidence.
- Legal: 30-day cure period before service suspension; customer responsible for VAT reverse-charge claims.

Action items:
- Hannah/Marissa: prepare MPA with the agreed fields (credit cap, early-pay rebate, invoice split) and send via DocuSign (include a PO field). Attach mutual_action_plan.xlsx to the DocuSign packet.
- Liam: upload UK VAT certificate and confirm the billing contact details for each entity.
- Vivek: confirm billing system can output entity-split invoices (reply-all when confirmed).

If there are no objections I'll start the DocuSign flow by tomorrow EOD.

Thanks,
Hannah
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
